headline: DiGiSPICE Technologies: NCLT Notice of Hearing for Company Scheme Petition
sum: DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited publishes newspaper notice of NCLT hearing on a company scheme petition, following Hon'ble NCLT order dated 6 August 2026 mandating publication of the notice.
implication: The scheme petition is now in the formal hearing phase under IBC 2016 / Companies Act 2013; creditors and stakeholders have statutory notice and timeline to file objections or claims before NCLT adjudication.
detail: DiGiSPICE Technologies has published the requisite newspaper notice (as mandated by the 6 August 2026 NCLT order) announcing the date, time, and venue of the scheme hearing. This is a procedural gate in corporate restructuring under Section 230–232 of the Companies Act 2013 read with the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016. The filing with NSE indicates the notice has been formally communicated to market participants. No consideration or deal value is disclosed at this stage, as the scheme terms remain under judicial review.
